title: The Last Tickets
intro: Your favourite band is sold out. Someone in a fan group has two tickets to sell.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: I have two tickets, face value!

banner: Message request · from a fan group member

msg: for Saturday at face value, €90 each.
and I will email the tickets.

replies.text: Can I pay through a safer way, like a card?

msg: Cards and apps take fees, and I need the money quickly.

msg.text: Lots of people want them. Pay in 20 minutes.

replies.text: Can I see the tickets and the booking first?

msg.text: Here is a screenshot of the tickets.
Trust me, I am a fan like you.

replies.text: A screenshot can be copied. I will only buy through the official resale page.

two.label: Sold-out tickets at face value
two.lens: Sold-out tickets for exactly what they cost.
two.why: A hard-to-get item at a normal price is the bait.

sad.label: A sad story
sad.lens: A sick grandmother, to make you feel sorry.
sad.why: A sad story is a tool. It is not a reason to skip checks.

transfer.label: Transfer only
transfer.lens: He wants a bank transfer, not a card.
transfer.why: Transfers cannot be taken back. Cards let you dispute a payment.

nocard.label: "No cards"
nocard.lens: He refuses a safer way to pay.
nocard.why: An honest seller does not mind a safe payment.

rush.label: Hurry
rush.lens: Pay in 20 minutes or lose them.
rush.why: Rushing you is a pressure trick.

shot.label: A screenshot as proof
shot.lens: A picture of a barcode, which can be copied by anyone.
shot.why: A screenshot cannot prove you own a ticket.

trust.label: "Trust me"
trust.lens: He asks you to trust him.
trust.why: An honest seller offers proof, not trust.

actions.label: Buy only through the official resale page

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The group moderators removed the fake seller before more fans paid.

verify.line: The official resale page had real tickets with the venue's own guarantee. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The money was gone in minutes. No tickets ever arrived, and the account disappeared.

what_if.go_ahead: Insisting on a card payment, or the official resale page, would have ended it. A real seller accepts either.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the account as well protects other fans.

golden_rule: Never pay a stranger by transfer for tickets. Use the official resale page, or a payment you can dispute.

quick_check.q: A stranger offers sold-out tickets at face value, only by bank transfer, and sends a screenshot. What do you do?

options.text: Use only the official resale page

quick_check.explain: Transfers cannot be reversed and screenshots can be copied. Use the official resale page.

hints.nudge: How does the seller insist on being paid?

rows.v: Card or a protected payment service
